title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
authors: Jiayi Yao; Hanchen Li; Yuhan Liu; Siddhant Ray; Yihua Cheng; Qizheng Zhang; Kuntai Du; Shan Lu; Junchen Jiang
affiliations: University of Chicago, CUHK-Shenzhen, Stanford University, Microsoft Research
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading

problem_statement.en: In RAG requests containing multiple retrieved text chunks, reusable content is not always at the input prefix, and independently precomputed KV caches omit cross-attention with preceding text. Full KV recompute is expensive, while prefix caching and full KV reuse respectively provide limited acceleration or degrade generation quality.
problem_statement.zh: 在包含多個檢索文本 chunk 的 RAG request 中，可重用內容不一定位於 input prefix，而各自獨立預先計算的 KV cache 會遺漏其與前文的 cross-attention。Full KV recompute 成本高昂，而 prefix caching 與 full KV reuse 分別只能提供有限加速或會降低生成品質。

key_innovation.en: CacheBlend fuses independently precomputed KV caches at arbitrary input positions by selectively recomputing High-KV-Deviation (HKVD) tokens layer by layer to restore cross-attention while reusing the remaining KV tensors. It pipelines selective recomputation with per-layer KV loading so that slower storage can be used without adding TTFT when loading hides recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: CacheBlend 可在任意 input position 融合各自獨立預先計算的 KV cache；其逐層選擇 High-KV-Deviation (HKVD) tokens 進行 selective recompute，以恢復 cross-attention，並重用其餘 KV tensors。系統將 selective recompute 與逐層 KV 載入形成 pipeline，使載入延遲足以遮蔽重算時可使用較慢儲存而不增加 TTFT。

baselines_compared: Full KV recompute, Prefix caching, Full KV reuse, MapReduce, MapRerank

key_improvements.en: CacheBlend reduces TTFT by 2.2–3.3× and increases inference throughput by 2.8–5× versus full KV recompute, with negligible generation-quality loss across four datasets and three models.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 full KV recompute，CacheBlend 將 TTFT 降低 2.2–3.3×，並將 inference throughput 提升 2.8–5×；在四個資料集與三個模型上僅有可忽略的生成品質損失。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Question Answering (QA), Summarization
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A40, 128 GB RAM, 1 TB NVMe SSD

reuse_metric.en: A 5%–18% selective recompute ratio limits the F1/Rouge-L loss to at most 0.002 versus full KV recompute across all four datasets on Yi-34B.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 Yi-34B 的四個資料集上，5%–18% 的 selective recompute ratio 使相較於 full KV recompute 的 F1/Rouge-L 損失至多為 0.002。
